title: Thunder in the Territories
author: ZooReddit
selftext:
I've been working on this idea I've had of a map and card game based around the old territory days of pro wrestling. It took a few iterations but I feel like its finally "a game". I absolutely love if any of you can help play test. Any feedback would be legendary.  
  
Basically you play as the "booker" of one the legendary wrestling promotion and you are trying to expand your territory by having the best heat drawing shows in the country. Book card-driven shows, build heat, and conquer the map before your rivals get over on you. 

[https://zooitch.itch.io/thunderterritories](https://zooitch.itch.io/thunderterritories)

Full game details:  
  
The game is set in the fractured wrestling landscape of 1983, around the era portrayed in The Iron Claw, when the industry was divided into competing regional territories instead of being dominated by one national company. You take control of one of nine promotions, including Vince McMahon Sr.’s WWF in the Northeast, Bill Watts’ Mid South, Stu Hart’s Stampede Wrestling out of Calgary, and six others. Over a 28 week season, you compete against rival promotions as everyone expands across the same map and fights for control of the wrestling business. 

Each week, you build your show through a card based match system. You book wrestlers into a main event, mid card, and undercard, call the winner before the bell, and then play the matches live using cards from five categories: openings, gimmicks, stipulations, finishes, and angles. The goal is to combine cards in ways that build heat. Bonuses are based on how the cards interact with each other, not just on who wins the match. Storylines also develop across multiple shows, progressing from a new program into a heater, climax, and blowoff. The longer you build them properly, the more heat they generate. Leave them sitting too long and they can go stale. Everything you do on the card feeds back into the territory map. The heat and momentum from your shows strengthen your hold on the region and put pressure on rival promotions nearby. 

There is a tutorial the first time you play, so you do not need to know how everything works going in. Would love to know what would be more helpful in the tutorial This is still a very early prototype. It has placeholder graphics, missing assets, and plenty of rough edges. It honestly looks pretty bad right now, but I am trying to make sure the gameplay and mechanics are strong before I spend a huge amount of time creating all the final artwork. 

If you have some time, I would really appreciate you giving it a shot and letting me know what you think. I mainly want to know whether it is fun, what feels confusing, what you would change, and whether it works properly on your phone or computer. Any feedback would be incredibly helpful, even if you only play for a few minutes.
